limitations: Single-centre cohort (Children's Hospital St. Hedwig, Regensburg, 2016-2021); external generalisability unknown.
Small sample size (n=782) with ~53 features; high risk of overfitting and wide confidence intervals.
Diagnosis label for conservatively managed patients is partly defined by Alvarado/PAS and appendix diameter -> circularity risk for those columns.
Many ultrasound findings are >70% missing because they were only recorded when the appendix or a complication was visualised; missingness is informative, not MCAR.
Free-text German columns (Diagnosis_Presumptive, Lymph_Nodes_Location, Abscess_Location, Gynecological_Findings) require controlled normalisation.
Ultrasound images (523 MB zip) are optional for the tabular Phase A model and are not downloaded in Phase 1.
No protected health information expected (de-identified research release), but no independent DPIA/IRB review has been performed in this project.

stages.name: Data Cleansing (Agent 1)
stages.purpose: Objective extraction, missing-data report, red flags. No diagnosis.

stages.name: Independent Differential
stages.purpose: Opponent forms a differential from raw evidence BEFORE seeing any anchor.

stages.name: Proponent Argument (Agent 2)
stages.purpose: Strongest evidence-based case for the classifier's top prediction.

stages.name: Opponent Attack (Agent 3)
stages.purpose: Attacks the leading hypothesis citing patient/retrieved evidence only.

stages.name: High-Acuity Watchdog (Agent 4)
stages.purpose: Rule-first, prediction-blind red-flag screening vs cited pediatric criteria.

stages.name: Arbitration (Agent 5)
stages.purpose: Weighted synthesis — explicitly not majority voting; confidence ≠ model probability.

stages.name: Bias Audit
stages.purpose: CBR / AOR / BCR / HFR / CRR / stability computed and persisted per case.

agents.name: Data Cleanser
agents.output: structured JSON: demographics, vitals, labs, symptoms, findings, missing critical info, red flags, data-quality warnings
agents.rule: Must not diagnose. Must not invent pediatric thresholds.

agents.name: Proponent
agents.output: supported_diagnosis, model_probability, supporting_evidence, missing_expected_evidence, contradictions_acknowledged, confidence
agents.rule: Must acknowledge contradictions; SHAP wording is non-causal.

agents.name: Opponent / Devil's Advocate
agents.sees: stage 2: raw evidence only; stage 4: hypothesis to attack
agents.output: challenged_hypothesis, contradictory_evidence, missing_criteria, alternative_diagnoses, strongest_alternative, disconfirmatory_tests, anchoring_risk
agents.rule: Every challenge must cite actual evidence; no disagreement for its own sake.

agents.name: High-Acuity Watchdog
agents.output: conditions_considered, red_flags_present/absent, cannot_assess, urgent_rule_outs, risk_level, evidence
agents.rule: High sensitivity, evidence-grounded; fail-closed on pending rules.

agents.name: Pediatric Consultant / Arbitrator
agents.output: primary_working_diagnosis, multi_agent_confidence, critical_differentials, urgent_rule_outs, disagreement, bias-risk before/after, audit_trail, disclaimer
agents.rule: Not majority voting; confidence must not reuse the model probability.

bias_metrics.name: Beneficial Correction Rate
bias_metrics.formula: incorrect initial diagnoses corrected / incorrect initial diagnoses

bias_metrics.name: Harmful Flip Rate
bias_metrics.formula: correct → incorrect after debate / initially correct

bias_metrics.name: Contradiction Recovery Rate
bias_metrics.formula: appropriate revisions on decisive new contradicting evidence / such cases

bias_metrics.name: Critical Miss Rate
bias_metrics.formula: high-acuity targets missed / high-acuity targets present
